in_arabic.name: عبد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم يعبر عن العبادة والخضوع لله تعالى، مستمد من الجذر العربي عبد، ويحمل الدلالة على العبد الذي يخدم ربه بكل إخلاص، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي ليعبر عن التوجه الروحي والتوكل على الله

in_urdu.name: عبد

in_pashto.name: عباد
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د الله عبادت او بندي کوونکي په معني کې دی، او په افغان/پښتنو دود کې دا نوم د روحاني معني او الله ته د اعتماد په نښه کې کارول شوی دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibad carries a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the Arabic root "abd" which means "servant." Historically, the term has been used to describe individuals who have devoted themselves completely to serving and following the teachings of Allah. This dedicated commitment to following God's commandments is a fundamental aspect of Islamic culture and the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ibad holds a great significance as it serves as a reminder of each individual's role as a servant of Allah. The name underscores the belief that every person is created to worship and serve their Creator, and that their actions and intentions should be deeply rooted in this fundamental purpose. It also embodies the essence of humility and submission to the will of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibad ibn Samit was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the ten promised Paradise. The name Ibad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibad was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is considered a saint in some Islamic traditions.
